# 1 Chronicles 13 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 13 (14 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.4 — "enthusiastically" addition
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "All the assembly agreed to do so" / **PNEUMA:** "enthusiastically agreed"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** No "enthusiastically" — not present in the Hebrew.

---

## V.8 — "wildly" addition to celebration
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "celebrating before God with all their might" / **PNEUMA:** "celebrated wildly"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "celebrating before God with all their might" — "wildly" adds a connotation not in *mesachakim*.

---

## V.10 — Dramatic additions to death report
- **LOGOS:** "he struck him down...he died there before God" / **PNEUMA:** "struck him dead on the spot"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS wording — the Hebrew is terse; PNEUMA's additions are dramatic but extrapolative.

---
*— SOPHIA*
